comingLast.roast: 5 left, 3 needed, one bar holding its breath
2 clear - his supporters (his group) keep reminding him loudly
2 points of daylight - barely enough to read by
2 clear with 6 to play - points only go up, but so does the tension
3 points is all that separates him from a very blue evening
above the blue balls by 3 - margin thinner than the clubhouse gravy
clear of Somerville by 4 - nobody tell him, he plays worse informed
6 clear with holes in hand - the maths likes him, the course may not
